citadelSeparation.platformAdministration: Citadel management, connectivity and AI-governance subscriptions use separately eligible administrator groups; membership does not grant Stratton production data access.
citadelSeparation.workloadAdministration: Stratton production operators have no standing Citadel tenant-policy, connectivity or AI-governance administration rights.
citadelSeparation.assuranceAdministration: Internal Audit controls sub-citadel-stratton-assurance-prod; Citadel platform and workload delivery identities cannot assign themselves assurance roles.
citadelSeparation.regionalScope: Primary and recovery role assignments use the same approved duty model but separate resource scopes and audit evidence.

principles: All human access uses Stratton-controlled Microsoft Entra identities.
Privileged production access is restricted to approved EU-based personnel through Conditional Access and PIM; network location alone is not treated as proof of personnel location.
No standing Owner or User Access Administrator assignment is permitted for workload delivery or operations.
Every workload component and environment has a separate user-assigned managed identity.
SQL authentication, shared service principals, client secrets, stored credentials and GitHub OIDC are prohibited.
Emergency access follows the tenant-approved process, is alerted immediately and reviewed after use.

humanGroups.rights: Read admitted evidence; validate material output; no policy or source administration.
Approve legal, sanctions and externally sourced conclusions.
PIM-eligible least-privilege platform operations; no application data by default.
PIM-eligible security operations and incident evidence; no verdict modification.

humanGroups.scope: Assurance subscription and read-only evidence export
humanGroups.rights: Read complete acceptance evidence; create and retain verdict; delivery has no reciprocal write access.
Review alerts and post-use evidence; no routine operational role.

permissions: Key Vault Secrets User for its vault objects
Storage Blob Data Reader for admitted evidence
Storage Blob Data Contributor on quarantine and admitted containers
Storage Blob Data Reader on admitted evidence
Cognitive Services User for Document Intelligence
Storage Blob Data Reader on admitted derived content
Storage Blob Data Contributor on append-only audit landing container
denied: audit object overwrite after immutability lock

permissions: Resource-type-specific deployment roles scoped to target resource groups
denied: Internal Audit assurance subscription except explicit evidence-drop resource

pimSettings.productionActivation: Approval required, justification and ticket/evidence ID required, phishing-resistant MFA required, time-bound duration set by Identity Lead, notification and audit enabled.
pimSettings.accessReviews: Periodic frequency is an owner-approved parameter; stale eligibility is removed.
pimSettings.separation: Deployment role cannot assign itself roles. Role Assignment writes require a separately activated identity-governance role.
pimSettings.emergency: Emergency identity design must be supplied by the tenant Identity Lead; this design does not invent account count, role or credential storage.

sqlAuthorisation.serverAdmin: Dedicated Entra group; PIM-controlled; not an application identity
sqlAuthorisation.rowLevelSecurity: Enforce case and role scope where the approved access model requires it; exact entitlements are a Phase 4 data-owner task.

keyVault.cmkDecision: Platform-managed encryption is the baseline. Customer-managed keys are not asserted as required; CISO/Legal may require them through an explicit decision with availability and key-operations impact.
